question_text: What are pleomorphic bacteria? Give an example.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Pleomorphic bacteria defined
steps.margin_note: Definition with both causes named. Three lines.
lines: PLEOMORPHIC bacteria are bacteria that can
CHANGE THEIR SHAPE, depending on the
environmental conditions and the nutrition available.
steps.why: Most bacteria hold one shape for life, so the ones that do not need a name of their own.
common_mistakes: Saying pleomorphic means many species. Pleo-morphic means many SHAPES.
Leaving out the cause. The shape changes with conditions and nutrition.
steps.memory_tip: Pleo means many, morph means shape.

steps.label: Example
steps.margin_note: One named example plus the contrast with fixed-shape bacteria.
lines: Ordinary bacteria keep one fixed shape — coccus,
bacillus, vibrio or spirillum — throughout life.
steps.why: Setting the example against the fixed shapes makes clear what is unusual about it.
common_mistakes: Naming no example. The question asks for one.
Naming a virus. The question is about BACTERIA.
steps.memory_tip: Acetobacter is the one that will not hold a shape.
